items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I had another opportunity to play with a very fine band around home... Don Dunbar, whose real name was Lawrence Jefferson... he'd come back home and put a band together.

ctx.x: Oh, well, I didn't really pursue it. To this day I don't really pursue it. But I just wanted to know about it, you know. But I had the occasion to write some things later on, and I've been writing a little bit here and a little bit there ever since.

I had another opportunity to play with a very fine band around home. The other band was just more modern than Doc's band. It had more special arrangements, we called it in those days. They had several good writers in there. Don Dunbar, whose real name was Lawrence Jefferson, he taught music at Howard University and he was a very fine writer, but he'd come back home and put a band together. He had very good arrangements.
